question: Should ClickClack permanently expose separate persisted alignment preferences for the current user's messages and all other participants' messages?
rationale: The implementation and proof can establish technical correctness, but they cannot determine whether two independent appearance controls are the intended long-term UX and settings contract.

options.title: Approve two controls
options.body: Keep both independently persisted selectors and land the branch after resolving its merge conflict and revalidating the resulting head.

options.title: Keep one control
options.body: Decline the additional preference and retain the existing single-setting appearance model to minimize configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Approve two controls
recommendation.body: Keep both independently persisted selectors and land the branch after resolving its merge conflict and revalidating the resulting head.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a permanent product and UX surface decision rather than a remaining mechanical defect.
